Population increased in South Yorkshire (county)

The estimated population of South Yorkshire (county) in 2024 was 1,430,623 usual residents, a rise of 1.3% since 2023.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of South Yorkshire (county) increased by 4.1%.

Age profile of South Yorkshire (county)

The average (median) age fell to 39.4 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of South Yorkshire (county) has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
By age category, South Yorkshire (county)'s population of 1,430,623 usual residents was made up of:

  • 262,483 people aged 0 to 15 years, (18.3%)
  • 902,793 people aged 16 to 64 years, (63.1%)
  • 265,347 people aged 65 years and over, (18.5%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, South Yorkshire (county) has a similar proportion of people in these age categories.

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In South Yorkshire (county), the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net international migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in South Yorkshire (county)
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for South Yorkshire (county), between 2023 and 2024:

  • More deaths than births led to a fall in the population of 274 people (0%). In total, there were 14,067 births and 14,341 deaths in South Yorkshire (county).
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 1,707 (0.1%). There were 52,146 people entering the area and 50,439 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in South Yorkshire (county)'s population of 16,341 (1.2%) as a result of 26,716 people entering the area and 10,375 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for South Yorkshire (county) was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of South Yorkshire (county) in mid-2023 is 1,412,806.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 4,154 people and internal migration estimates were revised upwards by 1,580 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 5,734 people.
